PCR1adds4uL enzyme/dNTP/buffer/primer mix; PCR2adds1uL buffer/forward/wellreverse mix and uses enzyme/nucleotide carryover. These component ports do not mean fresh independent additions at PCR2. PCR3after two purifications receives a fresh supply interface with enzyme identity/formulation unassigned in the inspected20uL recipe, rather than presumed PCR1enzyme carryover. Final agarose/BioAnalyzer material, retained library, loading aliquot and untransferred stock remain distinct. NextSeq500 alone does not assign a readlength, acquired indexmask, sequencing-primer landing or complete well/plate barcode position. Full ID-seq predecessor strands and exact well/plate primer sequences remain unassembled; the known local amplification primers remain source-exact. No bulk RNA/ChIP validation library is used as an extra scID output.
